description: Only the evidence-backed HSN candidate corrections from the SKU-level audit. The other catalogue HSN fields remain as previously recorded.

records.hsn_description: Fittings of plastics for tubes, pipes and hoses
records.hsn_basis: The catalogue identifies this article as a coolant-pipe socket/coupler, not a prepared coolant. A plastic pipe-fitting heading is the current candidate.
records.hsn_review_note: Verify the fitting body material and construction. Use 39174000 only for plastic fittings; steel and copper-alloy fittings require their own tariff headings.

records.hsn_description: Steering wheels, steering columns and steering boxes; parts thereof
records.hsn_basis: Exact part F0987915 is listed as a pivot pin; Souviks identifies the assembly as a steering relay/drop-arm pivot. It is a mechanical steering item, not an electrical relay.
records.hsn_review_note: Confirm the supplied part's dedicated steering-linkage function and whether it is a standalone pin or part of a complete linkage assembly.

records.hsn_description: Other endless V-ribbed transmission belts, outside circumference >60 cm and <=180 cm
records.hsn_basis: Fenner part number 4PK-986SPV and the product's V-ribbed/Poly-V description identify a ribbed accessory-drive belt, not a non-V-ribbed trapezoidal belt. Candidate 40103190 applies if verified outside circumference is 60–180 cm and rubber compound is not below 25% by weight.
records.hsn_review_note: Obtain Fenner datasheet confirming actual outside circumference and rubber-compound content. 986 mm is the nominal/effective length marking and is not, by itself, proof of the statutory outside-circumference measurement. If <25% rubber compound use 40103110; if the circumference is outside 60–180 cm use the corresponding tariff band.

records.hsn_description: Other filtering or purifying machinery and apparatus for liquids
records.hsn_basis: Bosch's commercial-vehicle filter catalogue maps exact OE reference X4000700 to a coolant filter; this is filtering equipment, not antifreeze fluid.
records.hsn_review_note: Confirm whether the supplied SKU is a complete coolant-filter apparatus or a replacement element/part (which may fall under 84219900).

records.hsn_description: Gear boxes and parts thereof
records.hsn_basis: The product is described as a gear-lever knob used at the driver's transmission gear-selection interface, not a plastic closure.
records.hsn_review_note: Confirm whether it is a dedicated gearbox/gear-selection part or a standalone knob whose material/function requires a different heading.

records.hsn_description: Other endless V-belts (not V-ribbed), outside circumference >60 cm and <=180 cm
records.hsn_basis: PIX AVX13-family product is a trapezoidal V-belt; the catalogue part-number size is 1325 mm, within the 60–180 cm tariff circumference band if the size marking is the belt outside circumference.
records.hsn_review_note: Verify exact non-V-ribbed section, measured outside circumference and rubber-compound content by weight. If rubber compound is below 25%, use 40103210; otherwise 40103290 is the candidate.

records.hsn_description: Other switches for electrical circuits not exceeding 1,000 V
records.hsn_basis: Uno Minda's manufacturer brochure for exact part LSC-24V87 (Lift Axle Solenoid, TATA/LEYLAND 24V) explicitly publishes HSN 85365090; the item is also listed by Uno Minda under Switch, Relay & Sensor.
records.hsn_review_note: Manufacturer-published product-level HSN is recorded. Keep the GST rate separately unassigned until the exact description is matched to the current Notification 9/2025 schedule and its applicable entry; HSN 85365090 can map to more than one GST-rate entry depending on description.
